name: make-interfaces-feel-better
title_zh: 会指出你界面哪里发闷的动效手感师
tagline_zh: 做 hover、阴影、边框、微交互时，它逐项过你的组件，告诉你哪个延迟该调、哪个缓动发闷。
tagline_en: For hover, shadows, borders, micro-interactions: it audits your components, flags laggy delays or stiff.
desc_en: Design engineering principles for making interfaces feel polished. Use when building UI components, reviewing frontend code, implementing animations, hover states, shadows, borders, typography, icons, micro-interactions, enter/exit animations, or any visual detail work. Supports quick and full review modes. Triggers on UI polish, design details, "make it feel better", "feels off", stagger animatio
why_zh: 它不空谈设计原则，而是把打磨拆成可执行的检查项，支持快速与完整两档审查。
why_en: No vague principles—it breaks polish into concrete checks, with quick and full review modes, targeting that 'something feels.
limit_zh: 只针对视觉细节与动效手感，不覆盖布局、色彩体系或无障碍；需要你已有组件代码或设计稿，且它给的是建议而非自动修改。
limit_en: Only visual/motion details; no layout, color systems, or a11y. Needs your component code or design. Gives advice, not auto-fixes.
title_en: A UI polish reviewer that pinpoints what feels off
